p.i: The teaching Alma, the high priest belonging to the Holy Order of God, delivered to the people in their cities and villages throughout the land.

chapter.li: LEChapter5 Verse1 Alma started teaching God’s word to the people, first in Zarahemla, and afterward throughout the land. VerseEnd Verse2 This is what he taught the congregation in the city of Zarahemla, according to his own record: VerseEnd Verse3 I Alma was ordained by my father Alma to be a high priest over God’s congregation, since he had power and authority from God to do so. He started to establish a congregation in the land that bordered the land of Nephi, a place called Mormon. He baptized his followers in the waters of Mormon. VerseEnd Verse4 I testify they were liberated from king Noah’s control by God’s mercy and power. VerseEnd Verse5 Subsequently they were enslaved by the Lamanites. But the Lord delivered them again from slavery by the power of His word. We were then led to this land and began to establish God’s congregation here and throughout this land. VerseEnd

Verse6 Now I ask all 2PP you who belong to this congregation: Have 2PP you remembered 2PP your fathers’ captivity? Have 2PP you also remembered God’s mercy and long-suffering toward them? Have 2PP you also carefully considered how He rescued their souls from hell? VerseEnd Verse7 He changed their hearts; He woke them from a deep sleep and they woke up to God. They were surrounded by darkness; but their souls emerged into the light of God’s everlasting word. They were bound by the chains of death and hell, and faced everlasting destruction. VerseEnd Verse8 So I ask: Were they destroyed? I answer: No, they were not. VerseEnd Verse9 I also ask: Were the chains of death broken? Were the chains of hell surrounding them removed? I say: Yes, they were removed. And their souls grew in understanding and they sang of redeeming love. I testify they’re saved. VerseEnd Verse10 Now I ask: What are the conditions for their salvation? On what basis did they hope for salvation? How were they freed from the chains of death and hell? VerseEnd Verse11 I’ll tell 2PP you the answer: Didn’t my father Alma believe in the words taught by Abinadi? And wasn’t he a holy prophet? Didn’t he speak God’s words and my father Alma believed them? VerseEnd Verse12 Because of his faith, a powerful change happened in his heart. I testify this is all true. VerseEnd Verse13 He preached the word to 2PP your parents, and changed their hearts as well, and they humbled themselves and trusted the true and living God. Then they were faithful until the end; so they were saved. VerseEnd

Verse14 Now I ask 2PP you, my brothers and sisters of the congregation: Have 2PP you spiritually been born of God? Have 2PP you received His image in 2PP your own countenances? Have 2PP you experienced this powerful change to 2PP your hearts? VerseEnd Verse15 Do 2PP you rely on faith in the redemption of the Lord who created 2PP you? Do 2PP you faithfully anticipate rising from the grave to immortality, freed from degeneration, illness, and corruption, to stand before God and be judged based on what 2PP you’ve done in the mortal body? VerseEnd Verse16 I ask: Can 2PP you expect to hear the Lord’s voice then saying to 2PP you: Come to Me, blessed one; 2PP your works have been righteous on the earth? VerseEnd Verse17 Or do 2PP you imagine being able to lie to the Lord and claim: Lord, our works on earth have been righteous (even when they were not), and He’ll save 2PP you? VerseEnd Verse18 Or can 2PP you instead foresee standing before God’s judgment seat filled with guilt and remorse, remembering clearly all 2PP your guilt and wickedness, knowing 2PP you’ve defied God’s commandments? VerseEnd Verse19 I ask: Can 2PP you look up to God on that day with a pure heart and clean hands? I ask: Can 2PP you look up, having the image of God engraved on 2PP your countenances? VerseEnd Verse20 I ask: Can 2PP you think of being saved when 2PP you’ve allowed yourselves to obey the accuser? VerseEnd Verse21 I say: 2PP You will then know 2PP you can’t be saved; because no one can be saved unless their clothes are clean, purified, and every trace of sin and iniquity removed through the blood of Him our fathers testified was appointed to come to redeem His people from their sins. VerseEnd

Verse22 Now I ask 2PP you, my brothers and sisters: How will any of 2PP you feel when standing before God’s judgment bar, with 2PP your clothes stained with blood and all kinds of filthiness? What will these things prove about 2PP you? VerseEnd Verse23 Won’t they prove 2PP you are murderers, guilty of all kinds of wickedness? VerseEnd Verse24 My people, do 2PP you think anyone can have a place in God’s kingdom with Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the holy prophets, wearing clothes that aren’t cleansed and spotless, pure, and white? VerseEnd Verse25 I’m telling 2PP you: That’s impossible unless our Creator is a liar from the start, or 2PP you would have to believe He’s a liar from the start. 2PP You can’t think such a person will be welcome in the kingdom of heaven; they’ll be thrown out since they belong in the accuser’s kingdom. VerseEnd

Verse26 Now, my people, consider this: If 2PP you’ve experienced a change of heart and felt moved to sing the song of redeeming love, I would ask, Do 2PP you still feel that way? VerseEnd Verse27 Have 2PP you been keeping yourselves innocent before God? If 2PP you were to die now, could 2PP you honestly say 2PP you’ve been humble enough, that 2PP your clothes have been cleansed and made white through the blood of Christ — who is coming to redeem His people from their sins? VerseEnd Verse28 Are 2PP you stripped of pride? I tell 2PP you that if 2PP you’re not, then 2PP you aren’t prepared to come face to face with God. 2PP You must prepare now; because the kingdom of heaven is coming soon, and 2PP you won’t have eternal life. VerseEnd Verse29 Again I ask 2PP you: Is there any one of 2PP you not stripped of jealousy? I tell 2PP you anyone who’s not, is not prepared and won’t be found innocent. And I urge 2PP you to prepare quickly, since the time is near; and we don’t know when the time arrives. VerseEnd

Verse30 I ask 2PP you again: Is there any one of 2PP you who mocks their brother or sister or who mistreats them? VerseEnd Verse31 Woe to anyone like this, because they aren’t prepared; the time is short for them to repent or they can’t be saved. VerseEnd Verse32 Indeed, woe to everyone who commits iniquity. Repent! Repent, because the Lord God requires it. VerseEnd Verse33 He invites all mankind — the arms of mercy are extended toward them. He pleads: Repent, and I will receive 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse34 He says: Come to Me and 2PP you’ll partake of the fruit of the tree of life; 2PP you’ll eat and drink freely of the bread and waters of life. VerseEnd Verse35 Come to Me and do righteous works and 2PP you won’t be cut down and cast into the fire. VerseEnd Verse36 The time is near when anyone who’s failed to produce good fruit or didn’t do righteous works will have good reason to weep and mourn. VerseEnd

Verse37 All of 2PP you that commit iniquity, take pride in empty, worldly things and have claimed to understand righteousness: 2PP you’ve wandered off like sheep without a shepherd, while a shepherd has called and is still calling 2PP you back, but 2PP you ignore His voice. VerseEnd Verse38 I declare the Good Shepherd is calling to 2PP you. He is calling for 2PP you in His own name, which is the name of Christ. But if 2PP you won’t respond to the Good Shepherd’s voice, to the name 2PP you’re called by, then 2PP you aren’t His sheep. VerseEnd Verse39 Now if 2PP you aren’t the sheep of the Good Shepherd, then to whose fold do 2PP you belong? I tell 2PP you the accuser is 2PP your shepherd, and 2PP you’re part of his fold. Who can deny this? I’m telling 2PP you whoever denies this is a liar and a child of the accuser. VerseEnd

Verse40 I testify whatever is good comes from God and whatever is evil comes from the accuser. VerseEnd Verse41 So if a person does good works, then they respond to the Good Shepherd’s voice and follow Him. But whoever does evil works becomes a child of the accuser, since they follow his voice and obey him. VerseEnd Verse42 Whoever does this will get their payment from him. He’ll compensate them with death as to righteousness, letting all good works in 2PP you die. VerseEnd Verse43 Now, my people, I want 2PP you to listen, because I sincerely plead from the core of my soul. I’ve spoken plainly to 2PP you so 2PP you won’t miss the point, based upon God’s commandments. VerseEnd Verse44 I’m called to speak in this way from the duty held by the Holy Order after the Order of the Son of God, Jesus Christ. It’s my obligation to stand and testify to this people about what our fathers have prophesied about what will happen. VerseEnd Verse45 And this isn’t all. Do 2PP you think I don’t know personally about these things? I testify that everything I’ve spoken about is true. How do 2PP you think I know of their certainty? VerseEnd Verse46 I’ll tell 2PP you: They were revealed to me by God’s Holy Spirit. I’ve fasted and prayed many days to obtain personal knowledge of these things. And I know personally they’re true, since the Lord God has revealed them to me by His Holy Spirit; which is the Spirit of revelation that’s in me. VerseEnd Verse47 Just like it was revealed to me that the words of our fathers are true, the spirit of prophecy and revelation from the Spirit of God to me confirms VerseEnd Verse48 and therefore I personally know, what I told 2PP you about the future is true. I tell 2PP you that I know Jesus Christ, the Only Begotten of the Father, who’s full of grace, mercy, and truth, will come. He is coming to take away the sins of the world, the sins of every person firmly believing in His name. VerseEnd

Verse49 I testify this is the Holy Order I’ve been ordained into to preach to my dear people — and to everyone who lives in the land — to preach to all: the old and the young, the enslaved and the free, the middle-aged and the rising generation — to invite them all to repent and be born again. VerseEnd Verse50 Indeed, the Spirit says: Repent, everyone throughout the earth, because the kingdom of heaven is coming soon. The Son of God will come in His glory, strength, majesty, power, and dominion. My dear people, I tell 2PP you the Spirit says: The glory of the King of the whole earth and of the King of heaven will very soon be seen here with us. VerseEnd Verse51 And the Spirit directed me to go, use all my energy, and warn the people bluntly, saying: Repent! Because, unless 2PP you repent it’s impossible to inherit the kingdom of heaven. VerseEnd Verse52 I also testify the Spirit says: The ax is placed at the root of the tree, ready to cut down and throw into the everlasting, unquenchable fire every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit. Listen and remember! The Holy One has spoken it! VerseEnd

Verse53 Now, my dear people, I ask 2PP you: Can 2PP you deny these words? Can 2PP you set them aside and trample the Holy One under 2PP your feet? Can 2PP you be filled with pride to 2PP your very core? Will 2PP you continue displaying 2PP your extravagant clothes, setting 2PP your hearts on empty, worldly things — on 2PP your material possessions? VerseEnd Verse54 Will 2PP you persist in thinking 2PP you’re better than others? Will 2PP you continue to mistreat 2PP your brothers and sisters, who humble themselves and live according to the Holy Order of God, which brought them into this congregation, having been sanctified by the Holy Spirit? For they show by their works that they’ve truly repented. VerseEnd Verse55 Again, will 2PP you continue turning 2PP your backs on the poor and needy when 2PP you could easily help them? VerseEnd Verse56 Finally, all of 2PP you who insist on continuing to do evil, I tell 2PP you unless 2PP you quickly repent, this is what will get 2PP you cut down and thrown into the fire. VerseEnd

Verse57 Now all of 2PP you that wish to follow the voice of the Good Shepherd: Come and separate yourselves from the wicked and don’t touch their unclean things. Their names will be erased, dividing the names of the wicked from the names of the righteous, so that God’s word will be fulfilled, which says: The names of the wicked won’t be mixed in with the names of My people; VerseEnd Verse58 because the names of the righteous will be included in the Book of Life, and I’ll bestow upon them an inheritance at My right hand. Now, my people, how can 2PP you criticize this? I tell 2PP you: If 2PP you speak opposing it, it doesn’t matter, because God’s word will certainly be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse59 Indeed, does any shepherd with a flock fail to watch over them to prevent wolves from attacking and eating his flock? If a wolf enters his flock, doesn’t he drive it out? And ultimately, if he can, he’ll kill it. VerseEnd Verse60 Now I tell 2PP you the Good Shepherd is calling out to 2PP you. And if 2PP you’re willing to respond to His voice, He’ll bring 2PP you into His fold and 2PP you’ll be His sheep. He commands 2PP you not to let any ravenous wolf enter among 2PP you, to prevent 2PP you from being destroyed. VerseEnd

Verse61 And I give 2PP you the same command He gave to me: 2PP You must take care to do what I’ve told 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse62 This is a commandment to the congregation. For those who don’t belong to the congregation, I invite and ask 2PP you to come and be baptized as a sign of repentance, so 2PP you can also eat the fruit of the tree of life. VerseEnd
